steps: Cut the broccoli into florets, keeping some stalk on each.
Steam for 8-10 minutes until a fork slides in easily.
Let it cool before serving.
recipes.spoon: Blend with a little cooled boiled water or baby's usual milk until smooth. Make it thicker over the next few days.
recipes.finger: Offer whole florets with a long stalk to hold. They should squash easily between your finger and thumb.
recipes.fz: Purée freezes well in ice-cube trays.

steps: Cut into florets with a little stalk on each.
Steam for 8-10 minutes until very soft.
Let it cool before serving.
recipes.spoon: Blend or mash with a little cooled boiled water until smooth.
recipes.finger: Offer whole soft florets, stalk end first.
recipes.fz: Purée freezes well in ice-cube trays.

steps: Wash the courgette and cut it into finger-length batons.
Steam for 5-6 minutes until soft.
Let it cool before serving.
recipes.spoon: Mash with a fork until smooth.
recipes.finger: Offer the soft batons whole, about the length of an adult finger.

steps: Trim the ends.
Steam for 8-10 minutes until very soft.
Let it cool before serving.
recipes.spoon: Blend with a little cooled boiled water until smooth.
recipes.finger: Offer whole soft beans to hold.

steps: Peel and cut into finger-length batons.
Steam for 10-12 minutes until very soft. Never offer raw carrot at this age.
Let it cool before serving.
recipes.spoon: Blend or mash until smooth.
recipes.finger: Offer the soft batons. They should squash easily between finger and thumb.

steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Peel the parsnip and cut into finger-length wedges, removing any woody core.
Toss in the oil and roast for 25-30 minutes until soft right through.
Let it cool before serving.
recipes.spoon: Mash with a little cooled boiled water.
recipes.finger: Offer the soft wedges whole.

steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Peel, deseed and cut into finger-length wedges.
Toss in the oil and roast for 25-30 minutes until soft.
Let it cool before serving.
recipes.spoon: Mash until smooth.
recipes.finger: Offer the soft wedges whole.

steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Peel and cut into finger-length wedges.
Toss in the oil and roast for 25-30 minutes until soft right through.
Let it cool before serving.
recipes.spoon: Mash with a fork; loosen with a little baby's usual milk.
recipes.finger: Offer the soft wedges whole.

steps: Cook the peas in boiling water for 4 minutes.
Drain and mash well with the mint, if using.
Let it cool before serving.
recipes.spoon: Blend smooth, or mash and push through a sieve for the first few times.
recipes.finger: Squash each pea flat, or offer the mash on a preloaded spoon.

steps: Halve the avocado and remove the stone.
Scoop out the flesh; it should be soft and ripe.
recipes.spoon: Mash until smooth, adding a little baby's usual milk if needed.
recipes.finger: Cut into wide spears. Leave a strip of skin on one end for grip if it is slippery.

steps: Choose a ripe banana with a few brown spots.
recipes.spoon: Mash until smooth.
recipes.finger: Cut the half in two lengthways, or peel the top and leave the rest of the peel on as a handle.

steps: Peel, core and slice the pear.
If it is not very ripe and soft, steam the slices for 4-5 minutes until soft.
Let it cool before serving.
recipes.spoon: Blend or mash until smooth.
recipes.finger: Offer soft slices that squash easily between finger and thumb.

steps: Peel, core and cut the apple into wedges.
Simmer with the water, covered, for 8-10 minutes until very soft. Never offer raw apple chunks.
Let it cool before serving.
recipes.spoon: Mash or blend with the cooking water.
recipes.finger: Offer the soft cooked wedges.

steps: Peel the mango and cut the flesh away from the stone.
recipes.spoon: Mash or blend until smooth.
recipes.finger: Cut into wide spears that squash easily.

steps: Peel and dice the potato.
Put the mince and potato in a pan with the water, breaking the mince up finely.
Simmer, covered, for 15-20 minutes until the meat is cooked through with no pink and the potato is soft.
Let it cool before serving.
recipes.spoon: Blend with some of the cooking liquid until smooth.
recipes.finger: Mash together and shape into small, soft patties that squash easily.

steps: Cut the chicken and sweet potato into small pieces.
Simmer in the water, covered, for 15-20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through with no pink.
Let it cool before serving.
recipes.spoon: Blend with some of the cooking liquid until smooth.
recipes.finger: Shred the chicken into thin, soft strips and offer with sweet potato pieces.

steps: Rinse the lentils. Peel and dice the carrot.
Simmer together for 15-20 minutes until the lentils collapse and the carrot is soft.
Let it cool before serving.
recipes.spoon: Blend until smooth.
recipes.finger: Cook a little longer until thick, then offer on a preloaded spoon.

steps: If the pear is firm, peel, core and steam it for 4-5 minutes until soft. Let it cool.
Mash the pear and swirl in the yoghurt.
recipes.spoon: Serve as it is.
recipes.finger: Offer soft pear slices to dip, or the mix on a preloaded spoon.

intro.dose: First time: about 1/4 teaspoon of the yoghurt, stirred into the pear. Next time: 1/2 teaspoon. Then build up to the full amount over the next few days. Offer it at breakfast so you can watch your baby for the next 2 hours. Some reactions to milk come later, up to a few days afterwards: a rash, an eczema flare, vomiting, tummy pain or loose stools. If you see them, stop giving milk and talk to your doctor.

ing: Baby's usual milk (breast milk or formula)
steps: Warm the milk in a small pan.
Whisk in the semolina and cook, stirring, for 3-4 minutes until thick.
Let it cool, then stir in the pear, cooked soft and mashed (steam a firm pear for 4-5 minutes first).
recipes.spoon: Serve as it is.
recipes.finger: Let it thicken and offer it on a preloaded spoon.

intro.dose: First time: about 1/4 teaspoon of the cooked semolina, mixed into the pear. Next time: 1/2 teaspoon. Then build up to the full amount over the next few days. Offer it at breakfast so you can watch your baby for the next 2 hours. Some reactions to wheat come later, up to a few days afterwards: a rash, an eczema flare, vomiting, tummy pain or loose stools. If you see them, stop giving wheat and talk to your doctor.

steps: Boil the egg for 10 minutes until fully hard-boiled. Cool it in cold water and peel.
Mash the egg finely and mix it with the avocado.
recipes.spoon: Mash smoothly together.
recipes.finger: After the first few spoon doses: hard-boiled egg quarters, cut lengthways, with avocado spears.

intro.dose: First time: about 1/4 teaspoon of the mashed egg, mixed into the avocado. Next time: 1/2 teaspoon. Then build up to the full amount over the next few days. Offer it at breakfast so you can watch your baby for the next 2 hours. Some reactions to egg come later, up to a few days afterwards: a rash, an eczema flare, vomiting, tummy pain or loose stools. If you see them, stop giving egg and talk to your doctor.

ing: Baby's usual milk (breast milk or formula)
Smooth peanut butter (no added salt or sugar)
steps: Cook the oats in the milk for 3-4 minutes, stirring, until soft.
Mix the peanut butter with 1 tsp warm water until smooth and runny.
Stir it into the porridge and mash in the banana.
recipes.spoon: Serve as it is.
recipes.finger: Let it thicken and offer on a preloaded spoon. Never give peanut butter on its own.

intro.dose: First time: about 1/4 teaspoon of the thinned peanut butter, stirred into the porridge. Next time: 1/2 teaspoon. Then build up to the full amount over the next few days. Offer it at breakfast so you can watch your baby for the next 2 hours.

ing: Baby's usual milk (breast milk or formula)
steps: Peel, dice and boil the potato for 12-15 minutes until soft.
Poach the cod in simmering water for 6-8 minutes until it flakes and is cooked through.
Remove the skin and check carefully for bones.
Mash the fish and potato with the butter and milk.
recipes.spoon: Mash smoothly.
recipes.finger: Shape into small soft patties, or offer large soft flakes.

intro.dose: First time: about 1/4 teaspoon of the flaked cod, mashed into the potato. Next time: 1/2 teaspoon. Then build up to the full amount over the next few days. Offer it at breakfast so you can watch your baby for the next 2 hours.

steps: Stir the tahini into the yoghurt until smooth.
Mash the banana and fold it through.
recipes.spoon: Serve as it is.
recipes.finger: Offer banana halves to dip into the tahini yoghurt.

intro.dose: First time: about 1/4 teaspoon of the tahini, stirred into the yoghurt. Next time: 1/2 teaspoon. Then build up to the full amount over the next few days. Offer it at breakfast so you can watch your baby for the next 2 hours.

steps: Drain the tofu.
Blend or mash with the mango until smooth.
recipes.spoon: Serve as it is.
recipes.finger: Offer soft mango spears to dip into the tofu.

intro.dose: First time: about 1/4 teaspoon of the tofu, mashed into the mango. Next time: 1/2 teaspoon. Then build up to the full amount over the next few days. Offer it at breakfast so you can watch your baby for the next 2 hours. Some reactions to soya come later, up to a few days afterwards: a rash, an eczema flare, vomiting, tummy pain or loose stools. If you see them, stop giving soya and talk to your doctor.

ing: Baby's usual milk (breast milk or formula)
steps: Cook the oats in the milk for 3-4 minutes until soft.
Stir in the ground almonds and the mashed stewed apple.
recipes.spoon: Serve as it is.
recipes.finger: Let it thicken and offer on a preloaded spoon.

intro.dose: First time: about 1/4 teaspoon of the ground almonds, stirred into the porridge. Next time: 1/2 teaspoon. Then build up to the full amount over the next few days. Offer it at breakfast so you can watch your baby for the next 2 hours.

ing: Baby's usual milk (breast milk or formula)
Smooth cashew butter (no added salt or sugar)
steps: Cook the oats in the milk for 3-4 minutes until soft.
Mix the cashew butter with 1 tsp warm water until runny and stir it in.
Mash in the pear.
recipes.spoon: Serve as it is.
recipes.finger: Let it thicken and offer on a preloaded spoon.

intro.dose: First time: about 1/4 teaspoon of the thinned cashew butter, stirred into the porridge. Next time: 1/2 teaspoon. Then build up to the full amount over the next few days. Offer it at breakfast so you can watch your baby for the next 2 hours.

steps: Peel, dice and boil the potato for 12 minutes. Add the peas for the last 4 minutes.
Heat the prawns in boiling water for 2-3 minutes until piping hot. Never use raw or lightly cooked shellfish.
Chop the prawns very finely.
Mash everything together with the butter.
recipes.spoon: Mash smoothly.
recipes.finger: Shape into small soft patties.

intro.dose: First time: about 1/4 teaspoon of the finely chopped prawns, mixed into the potato. Next time: 1/2 teaspoon. Then build up to the full amount over the next few days. Offer it at breakfast so you can watch your baby for the next 2 hours.

ing: Baby's usual milk (breast milk or formula)
steps: Cook the oats in the milk for 3-4 minutes until soft.
Stir in the ground hazelnuts and mash in the pear.
recipes.spoon: Serve as it is.
recipes.finger: Let it thicken and offer on a preloaded spoon.

intro.dose: First time: about 1/4 teaspoon of the ground hazelnuts, stirred into the porridge. Next time: 1/2 teaspoon. Then build up to the full amount over the next few days. Offer it at breakfast so you can watch your baby for the next 2 hours.

steps: Peel and dice the sweet potato and steam or boil for 12-15 minutes until very soft.
Mash it well, then stir in the grated cheese while it is hot so it melts.
recipes.spoon: Mash until smooth; loosen with a little cooled boiled water if needed.
recipes.finger: Let it cool and offer on a preloaded spoon.

intro.dose: First time: about 1/4 teaspoon of the melted cheese, mixed into the mash. Next time: 1/2 teaspoon. Then build up to the full amount over the next few days. Offer it at breakfast so you can watch your baby for the next 2 hours. Some reactions to milk come later, up to a few days afterwards: a rash, an eczema flare, vomiting, tummy pain or loose stools. If you see them, stop giving milk and talk to your doctor.

steps: Cook the pasta (plain wheat pasta, not egg pasta) in plenty of unsalted water for 2-3 minutes longer than the packet says, until very soft.
Drain, mash the tomatoes into it with the oil, and chop or mash finely.
recipes.spoon: Mash or blend with a little of the cooking water until soft and spoonable.
recipes.finger: Offer the soft pasta shapes with the sauce, a few at a time.

intro.dose: First time: about 1/4 teaspoon of the soft pasta, mashed into the tomato. Next time: 1/2 teaspoon. Then build up to the full amount over the next few days. Offer it at breakfast so you can watch your baby for the next 2 hours. Some reactions to wheat come later, up to a few days afterwards: a rash, an eczema flare, vomiting, tummy pain or loose stools. If you see them, stop giving wheat and talk to your doctor.

info: pasta: plain wheat pasta, not egg pasta

steps: Boil the egg for 10 minutes so it is hard all the way through; cool it in cold water and peel.
Steam or boil the diced sweet potato for 12-15 minutes until very soft.
Mash the egg finely and mix it into the mashed sweet potato.
recipes.spoon: Mash until smooth; loosen with a little cooled boiled water or baby's usual milk.
recipes.finger: Let it cool and offer on a preloaded spoon.

intro.dose: First time: about 1/4 teaspoon of the mashed egg, mixed into the sweet potato. Next time: 1/2 teaspoon. Then build up to the full amount over the next few days. Offer it at breakfast so you can watch your baby for the next 2 hours. Some reactions to egg come later, up to a few days afterwards: a rash, an eczema flare, vomiting, tummy pain or loose stools. If you see them, stop giving egg and talk to your doctor.

ing: Smooth peanut butter (no added salt or sugar)
steps: Peel, core and dice the apple and simmer in a splash of water for 8-10 minutes until very soft; mash or blend.
Mix the peanut butter with 1 tsp warm water until smooth and runny, then stir it into the warm apple.
recipes.spoon: Serve as it is.
recipes.finger: Offer on a preloaded spoon. Never give peanut butter on its own.

intro.dose: First time: about 1/4 teaspoon of the thinned peanut butter, stirred into the apple. Next time: 1/2 teaspoon. Then build up to the full amount over the next few days. Offer it at breakfast so you can watch your baby for the next 2 hours.

steps: Peel and slice the carrot and steam or boil for 12-15 minutes until very soft.
Steam or poach the cod for 6-8 minutes until it flakes easily. Check it carefully for bones and skin.
Mash the fish into the carrot with the oil.
recipes.spoon: Mash until smooth; loosen with a little cooled boiled water.
recipes.finger: Offer soft flakes of fish with a soft carrot stick alongside.

intro.dose: First time: about 1/4 teaspoon of the flaked cod, mashed into the carrot. Next time: 1/2 teaspoon. Then build up to the full amount over the next few days. Offer it at breakfast so you can watch your baby for the next 2 hours.

steps: Peel and dice the sweet potato and steam or boil for 12-15 minutes until very soft; mash.
Mix the tahini with 1 tsp warm water until runny and stir it through the mash.
recipes.spoon: Serve as it is.
recipes.finger: Offer on a preloaded spoon. Never give tahini on its own.

intro.dose: First time: about 1/4 teaspoon of the thinned tahini, stirred into the mash. Next time: 1/2 teaspoon. Then build up to the full amount over the next few days. Offer it at breakfast so you can watch your baby for the next 2 hours.

steps: Peel and core the pear; simmer for 5 minutes if it is not soft.
Drain the tofu and mash or blend it with the pear until smooth.
recipes.spoon: Serve as it is.
recipes.finger: Let it thicken and offer on a preloaded spoon.

intro.dose: First time: about 1/4 teaspoon of the tofu, mashed into the pear. Next time: 1/2 teaspoon. Then build up to the full amount over the next few days. Offer it at breakfast so you can watch your baby for the next 2 hours. Some reactions to soya come later, up to a few days afterwards: a rash, an eczema flare, vomiting, tummy pain or loose stools. If you see them, stop giving soya and talk to your doctor.

steps: Peel, core and dice the pear and simmer in a splash of water for 5 minutes until very soft; mash or blend.
Stir the ground almonds into the warm pear.
recipes.spoon: Serve as it is.
recipes.finger: Offer on a preloaded spoon.

intro.dose: First time: about 1/4 teaspoon of the ground almonds, stirred into the pear. Next time: 1/2 teaspoon. Then build up to the full amount over the next few days. Offer it at breakfast so you can watch your baby for the next 2 hours.

ing: Smooth cashew butter (no added salt or sugar)
steps: Peel and dice the sweet potato and steam or boil for 12-15 minutes until very soft; mash.
Mix the cashew butter with 1 tsp warm water until runny and stir it through the mash.
recipes.spoon: Serve as it is.
recipes.finger: Offer on a preloaded spoon. Never give nut butter on its own.

intro.dose: First time: about 1/4 teaspoon of the thinned cashew butter, stirred into the mash. Next time: 1/2 teaspoon. Then build up to the full amount over the next few days. Offer it at breakfast so you can watch your baby for the next 2 hours.

steps: Peel and slice the carrot and steam or boil for 12-15 minutes until very soft.
Heat the prawns in simmering water for 2-3 minutes until piping hot all the way through.
Blend the prawns with the carrot and oil until smooth.
recipes.spoon: Blend until smooth; loosen with a little cooled boiled water.
recipes.finger: Offer the blended mash on a preloaded spoon; whole prawns are a choking risk at this age.

intro.dose: First time: about 1/4 teaspoon of the blended prawns, mixed into the carrot. Next time: 1/2 teaspoon. Then build up to the full amount over the next few days. Offer it at breakfast so you can watch your baby for the next 2 hours.

steps: Peel, core and dice the apple and simmer in a splash of water for 8-10 minutes until very soft; mash or blend.
Stir the ground hazelnuts into the warm apple.
recipes.spoon: Serve as it is.
recipes.finger: Offer on a preloaded spoon.

intro.dose: First time: about 1/4 teaspoon of the ground hazelnuts, stirred into the apple. Next time: 1/2 teaspoon. Then build up to the full amount over the next few days. Offer it at breakfast so you can watch your baby for the next 2 hours.

steps: Finely chop the onion and garlic and soften them in the oil for 5 minutes.
Peel and dice the sweet potato. Rinse the lentils.
Add the sweet potato, lentils, cumin and water. Simmer for 20 minutes until the lentils collapse and the potato is soft.
recipes.spoon: Mash with soft lumps. Blend smoother for the first few times, then leave it lumpier.
recipes.finger: Cook it a little thicker, cool, and offer on a preloaded spoon with roasted sweet potato wedges.
recipes.fz: Freezes well. Defrost in the fridge overnight.

steps: Brown the mince in the oil, breaking it up finely, until there is no pink.
Peel and dice the carrot, potato and onion. Add them with the thyme and water.
Cover and simmer for 25 minutes until everything is soft.
recipes.spoon: Blend until smooth at first, then mash with soft lumps.
recipes.finger: Mash, cool, and shape into small soft patties. Serve soft carrot batons alongside.

steps: Cut the chicken into small pieces. Peel and dice the squash and onion.
Soften the onion in the oil for 3 minutes, then add everything else.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through with no pink.
recipes.spoon: Mash with soft lumps. Blend smoother for the first few times, then leave it lumpier.
recipes.finger: Shred the chicken into thin soft strips and offer with soft squash pieces.

ing: Baby's usual milk (breast milk or formula)
steps: Peel, dice and boil the potato for 15 minutes. Steam the broccoli for 8 minutes.
Heat the oven to 190°C and bake the salmon for 12 minutes until it flakes and is cooked through.
Remove the skin and check carefully for bones.
Mash everything together with the butter and milk.
recipes.spoon: Mash with soft lumps. Blend smoother for the first few times, then leave it lumpier.
recipes.finger: Shape the mash into soft fish fingers, or offer large soft flakes of salmon with broccoli florets.

steps: Brown the lamb in the oil, breaking it up finely, until there is no pink. Spoon off any extra fat.
Peel and dice the parsnip and onion and add with the thyme and water.
Simmer for 20 minutes, adding the peas for the last 4 minutes.
Mash or blend so the peas are squashed.
recipes.spoon: Mash with soft lumps. Blend smoother for the first few times, then leave it lumpier.
recipes.finger: Shape into small soft patties and offer with soft parsnip wedges.

steps: Brown the turkey in the oil, breaking it up finely, until there is no pink.
Peel, core and dice the apple; dice the courgette and onion.
Add them with the water and simmer for 15 minutes until the apple is very soft.
recipes.spoon: Mash with soft lumps. Blend smoother for the first few times, then leave it lumpier.
recipes.finger: Shape into small soft patties.

steps: Peel, dice and boil the potato for 15 minutes, adding the peas for the last 4 minutes.
Poach the cod in the milk with a little water for 6-8 minutes until it flakes.
Remove the skin and check carefully for bones.
Mash everything together with the butter and the cooking milk.
recipes.spoon: Mash with soft lumps. Blend smoother for the first few times, then leave it lumpier.
recipes.finger: Shape into small soft fishcakes.

steps: Soften the chopped onion, grated carrot and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the mince and cook, breaking it up finely, until there is no pink.
Add the rinsed lentils, tomatoes, oregano and water. Simmer for 25 minutes until thick.
recipes.spoon: Blend smooth at first, then leave it lumpier.
recipes.finger: Offer it thick on a preloaded spoon, or stir through soft pasta shapes once wheat has been introduced.

steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Peel and cube the squash, toss in the oil and cumin, and roast for 30 minutes until soft.
Blend or mash the squash with the chickpeas and lemon juice until there are no whole chickpeas.
recipes.spoon: Mash with soft lumps. Blend smoother for the first few times, then leave it lumpier.
recipes.finger: Offer the thick mash on a preloaded spoon, with a few soft roasted squash pieces.

steps: Steam the cauliflower and broccoli for 8-10 minutes until very soft.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the milk until thick and smooth.
Take off the heat and stir in the grated cheese until melted.
Mix the sauce with the vegetables.
recipes.spoon: Mash with soft lumps. Blend smoother for the first few times, then leave it lumpier.
recipes.finger: Offer the soft florets coated in sauce.

recipes.n: Pasta with tomato and lentil sauce
steps: Soften the chopped onion and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the rinsed lentils, tomatoes and water and simmer for 20 minutes. Stir in the basil and blend smooth.
Cook the pasta for 2 minutes longer than the packet says so it is very soft, then stir into the sauce.
recipes.spoon: Chop the pasta small and mash it into the sauce.
recipes.finger: Use larger shapes such as fusilli that are easy to grab, coated in the sauce.

steps: Soften the chopped onion in the oil for 5 minutes. Stir in the rice for 1 minute.
Add the water a ladle at a time, stirring, for 20-25 minutes until the rice is very soft. No stock: it is too salty.
Stir in the grated courgette and peas for the last 5 minutes, then the cream cheese.
Mash lightly so the peas are squashed.
recipes.spoon: Mash or blend to the texture your baby is used to.
recipes.finger: Let it cool and shape into soft balls.
recipes.note: Cool leftover rice within 1 hour, keep it in the fridge and use it within 24 hours.

steps: Blend the chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, oil, garlic and water until completely smooth. No salt.
Cut the carrot into batons and the broccoli into florets. Steam for 8-10 minutes until very soft.
recipes.spoon: Mash some of the vegetables into the hummus.
recipes.finger: Offer the soft vegetables to dip into the hummus.
recipes.note: Keep hummus in the fridge and use within 2 days.

ing: Baby's usual milk (breast milk or formula)
steps: Whisk the eggs with the milk and chives.
Cook in a non-stick pan over a low heat for 3-4 minutes, flip, and cook for 2 more minutes until fully set with no runny egg.
Cool and cut into strips.
recipes.spoon: Chop very finely and mash into a vegetable purée.
recipes.finger: Offer finger-length strips.
recipes.fz: Freezes well. Reheat until hot through, then cool.

steps: Peel and dice the carrot. Steam for 10 minutes, adding the peas for the last 4 minutes.
Blend or mash with the drained tofu and oil.
recipes.spoon: Mash with soft lumps. Blend smoother for the first few times, then leave it lumpier.
recipes.finger: Offer the thick mash on a preloaded spoon with soft carrot batons.

recipes.n: Mackerel, potato and green bean mash
steps: Peel, dice and boil the potato for 15 minutes. Steam the green beans for 8-10 minutes until very soft.
Heat the oven to 190°C and bake the mackerel for 10-12 minutes until cooked through.
Remove the skin and check very carefully for bones.
Mash the fish and potato with the yoghurt.
recipes.spoon: Mash with soft lumps. Blend smoother for the first few times, then leave it lumpier.
recipes.finger: Shape into soft patties and offer with the whole soft green beans.

steps: Dice the chicken, carrot and onion. Soften the onion in the oil for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken, rice, carrot, turmeric and water. Simmer for 20 minutes until the rice is very soft and the chicken is cooked through.
Add the peas for the last 4 minutes, then mash so they are squashed.
recipes.spoon: Mash with soft lumps. Blend smoother for the first few times, then leave it lumpier.
recipes.finger: Shape into soft balls when cool.
recipes.note: Cool leftover rice within 1 hour, keep it in the fridge and use it within 24 hours.

recipes.n: Pork, apple and sweet potato mash
steps: Brown the pork in the oil, breaking it up finely, until there is no pink.
Peel and dice the apple, sweet potato and onion and add with the thyme and water.
Simmer for 20 minutes until everything is very soft.
recipes.spoon: Mash with soft lumps. Blend smoother for the first few times, then leave it lumpier.
recipes.finger: Shape into small soft patties.

recipes.n: Peanut, chicken and sweet potato stew
ing: Smooth peanut butter (no added salt or sugar)
steps: Soften the chopped onion and garlic in the oil for 4 minutes.
Add the diced chicken and sweet potato, the tomatoes and the water. Simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Mix the peanut butter with 2 tbsp of the hot liquid until runny, then stir it into the stew.
recipes.spoon: Mash with soft lumps. Blend smoother for the first few times, then leave it lumpier.
recipes.finger: Shred the chicken into thin soft strips and offer with soft sweet potato pieces in the sauce.

recipes.n: Creamy cashew, cauliflower and chicken mash
ing: Smooth cashew butter (no added salt or sugar)
steps: Soften the chopped onion in the oil for 4 minutes with the garam masala.
Add the diced chicken, cauliflower florets and water. Simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Mix the cashew butter with 2 tbsp of the hot liquid until runny and stir it in.
recipes.spoon: Mash with soft lumps. Blend smoother for the first few times, then leave it lumpier.
recipes.finger: Offer soft cauliflower florets and shredded chicken coated in the sauce.

steps: Brown the lamb in the oil, breaking it up finely, until there is no pink. Spoon off any fat.
Add the chopped onion, diced squash, spices and water. Simmer for 20 minutes until the squash is soft.
Stir in the ground almonds to thicken.
recipes.spoon: Mash with soft lumps. Blend smoother for the first few times, then leave it lumpier.
recipes.finger: Shape into small soft patties and offer with soft squash pieces.

steps: Simmer the diced chicken, potato and courgette in the water for 18 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir the tahini with the lemon juice and 2 tbsp of the cooking water until smooth, and mix it in.
recipes.spoon: Mash with soft lumps. Blend smoother for the first few times, then leave it lumpier.
recipes.finger: Offer soft potato and courgette pieces with shredded chicken.

ing: Baby's usual milk (breast milk or formula)
steps: Cook the oats in the milk for 3-4 minutes, stirring, until soft.
Mash the pear (steam it first if it is firm) and stir it in.
recipes.spoon: Serve as it is.
recipes.finger: Let it thicken and offer on a preloaded spoon, with soft pear slices.

ing: Baby's usual milk (breast milk or formula)
steps: Cook the oats in the milk for 3-4 minutes, stirring, until soft.
Mash in the banana.
recipes.spoon: Serve as it is.
recipes.finger: Let it thicken and roll into soft balls, or use a preloaded spoon.

ing: Baby's usual milk (breast milk or formula)
steps: Cook the oats in the milk with the cinnamon for 3-4 minutes until soft.
Stir in the mashed stewed apple.
recipes.spoon: Serve as it is.
recipes.finger: Let it thicken and offer on a preloaded spoon.

steps: Mash the mango and swirl it through the yoghurt.
recipes.spoon: Serve as it is.
recipes.finger: Offer soft mango spears to dip.

steps: Mash the blueberries well, or cut each one lengthways into quarters.
Stir into the yoghurt.
recipes.spoon: Mash the berries smooth.
recipes.finger: Offer on a preloaded spoon; quartered berries only.

steps: Boil the egg for 10 minutes until fully hard-boiled. Cool in cold water and peel.
Toast the bread, spread thinly with butter and cut into narrow fingers.
recipes.spoon: Mash the egg finely with a little baby's usual milk.
recipes.finger: Offer egg quarters, cut lengthways, with the toast fingers.

steps: Mash the avocado and banana together until smooth.
recipes.spoon: Serve as it is.
recipes.finger: Offer avocado and banana spears.

recipes.n: Peanut butter and banana toast fingers
ing: Smooth peanut butter (no added salt or sugar)
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread a thin layer of peanut butter, then a thin layer of mashed banana.
Cut into narrow fingers.
recipes.spoon: Stir the peanut butter, thinned with warm water, into mashed banana instead.
recipes.finger: Offer the toast fingers. Never give peanut butter by the spoonful.

ing: Smooth cashew butter (no added salt or sugar)
steps: Mix the cashew butter with 1 tsp warm water until runny.
Stir it into the yoghurt and mash in the banana.
recipes.spoon: Serve as it is.
recipes.finger: Offer banana halves to dip.

steps: Stir the ground hazelnuts into the yoghurt.
Mash in the soft pear.
recipes.spoon: Serve as it is.
recipes.finger: Offer soft pear slices to dip.

recipes.n: Mini beef meatballs in tomato sauce
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Mix the mince, oats, egg, onion, courgette and oregano.
Roll into about 20 small balls and bake on a lined tray for 18-20 minutes until cooked through with no pink.
Meanwhile soften the garlic in the oil, add the tomatoes and basil, and simmer for 15 minutes. Blend smooth.
Add the meatballs to the sauce.
recipes.spoon: Mash the meatballs into the sauce.
recipes.finger: Cut each meatball in half or into quarters so the pieces are soft and small.

steps: Peel, dice and boil the potato for 15 minutes, adding the peas for the last 4 minutes. Drain and mash so the peas are squashed.
Heat the oven to 190°C and bake the salmon for 12 minutes. Flake it, removing the skin and checking carefully for bones.
Mix the salmon, mash, egg and dill. Shape into 8 small cakes and dust with the flour.
Turn the oven up to 200°C and bake the cakes on an oiled tray for 20 minutes, turning once, until golden and piping hot in the middle.
recipes.spoon: Mash a fishcake with a little cooled boiled water.
recipes.finger: Cut into fingers.
recipes.fz: Freeze before baking; bake from frozen for 25-30 minutes.

steps: Dice the chicken small and finely slice the leek.
Soften the leek in the oil and butter for 5 minutes. Add the chicken and cook until no longer pink.
Stir in the rice, then add the water a ladle at a time, stirring, for 20-25 minutes until soft. No stock: it is too salty.
Add the peas for the last 5 minutes and squash them lightly.
recipes.spoon: Chop into small soft pieces, or mash roughly if lumps are still new.
recipes.finger: Cool and shape into soft balls.
recipes.note: Cool leftover rice within 1 hour, keep it in the fridge and use it within 24 hours.

steps: Soften the chopped onion, garlic and ginger in the oil for 5 minutes. Stir in the spices for 1 minute.
Add the rinsed lentils, tomatoes and water and simmer for 25 minutes until thick and soft.
Cook the rice until very soft.
recipes.spoon: Mash the rice into the dhal.
recipes.finger: Offer thick dhal on a preloaded spoon and rice pressed into soft balls.
recipes.fz: Dhal freezes well; cook rice fresh.
recipes.note: Cool leftover rice within 1 hour, keep it in the fridge and use it within 24 hours.

steps: Whisk the eggs with the milk and stir in the cheese, pepper and courgette.
Cook in an oiled non-stick pan over a low heat for 4-5 minutes, flip, and cook for 2-3 minutes until fully set with no runny egg.
Cool and cut into fingers.
recipes.spoon: Chop into small soft pieces, or mash roughly if lumps are still new.
recipes.finger: Offer finger-length strips.

steps: Cook the pasta until soft, adding small broccoli florets for the last 6 minutes.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the milk until thick.
Off the heat, stir in the grated cheese until melted, then mix with the pasta and broccoli.
recipes.spoon: Chop into small soft pieces, or mash roughly if lumps are still new.
recipes.finger: Use larger pasta shapes that are easy to pick up.

steps: Soften the chopped onion, garlic, carrot and pepper in the oil for 8 minutes.
Add the courgette, paprika, tomatoes and beans. Simmer for 20 minutes until the vegetables are soft.
Squash every bean flat with a fork before serving.
recipes.spoon: Chop into small soft pieces, or mash roughly if lumps are still new.
recipes.finger: Offer soft vegetable pieces and squashed beans; it is thick enough to scoop with fingers.

steps: Peel, dice and steam the sweet potato for 12 minutes until soft.
Mash it with the chickpeas until there are no whole chickpeas, then mix in the egg, flour and cumin.
Fry spoonfuls in the oil for 3-4 minutes on each side until golden and cooked through.
recipes.spoon: Mash a fritter with a little cooled boiled water.
recipes.finger: Offer whole fritters or halves.

steps: Finely chop the onion, carrot, courgette and garlic and soften them in the oil for 8 minutes.
Add the mince and cook, breaking it up finely, until there is no pink.
Add the tomatoes, purée and oregano and simmer for 25 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti until soft and cut it into short lengths for the baby.
recipes.spoon: Chop into small soft pieces, or mash roughly if lumps are still new.
recipes.finger: Offer the short spaghetti lengths coated in sauce.

steps: Peel, dice and boil the potato for 15 minutes; mash with half the butter and 50 ml of the milk.
Poach the cod in the rest of the milk for 6 minutes. Lift it out, flake it, and check carefully for bones. Keep the milk.
Melt the remaining butter, stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the poaching milk until thick. Add the fish, peas and parsley.
Put in a dish, top with the mash and bake at 190°C for 20-25 minutes until piping hot.
Squash the peas in the baby's portion.
recipes.spoon: Chop into small soft pieces, or mash roughly if lumps are still new.
recipes.finger: Offer soft forkfuls to scoop, or press into small cakes.

steps: Cut the tofu into fingers and fry in half the oil until golden on each side.

Cut the vegetables into thin strips and steam the carrot for 5 minutes first. Stir-fry everything in the rest of the oil with the garlic and ginger for 6-8 minutes until each piece squashes easily between your finger and thumb. Add a splash of water if needed.
Cook the noodles until soft and cut into short lengths.
Mix the tahini with the lemon juice and 1 tbsp water and stir it through. No soy sauce for the baby.
recipes.spoon: Chop into small soft pieces, or mash roughly if lumps are still new.
recipes.finger: Offer tofu fingers, soft vegetable strips and short noodles.

steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and line a 12-hole mini muffin tin.
Mix the flour and baking powder. Whisk the egg, milk and oil and stir them in with the courgette and grated cheese.
Spoon into the tin and bake for 18-20 minutes until risen and cooked through.
recipes.spoon: Crumble into yoghurt.
recipes.finger: Offer a whole mini muffin or halves.
recipes.fz: Freezes well. Defrost in the fridge overnight, or bake from frozen for 8-10 minutes until hot all the way through, then let it cool.

steps: Brown the lamb, breaking it up finely, until there is no pink. Spoon off any fat.
Add the chopped onion and carrot, the lentils, purée, thyme and water. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Mash the lentils into the sauce with a fork.
Boil the peeled potato for 15 minutes and mash with the butter and milk. Spread over the meat and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until piping hot.
recipes.spoon: Chop into small soft pieces, or mash roughly if lumps are still new.
recipes.finger: Offer soft forkfuls, or press into small cakes.

recipes.n: Oven-baked cod goujons with squashed peas
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Check the cod for bones and cut it into finger-size strips.
Dust the strips in flour, dip in beaten egg, then press into the breadcrumbs.
Bake on an oiled tray for 15-18 minutes until golden and the fish flakes easily.
Cook the peas for 4 minutes and squash them with a fork.
recipes.spoon: Flake the fish into the squashed peas.
recipes.finger: Offer the goujons whole.
recipes.fz: Freeze before baking; bake from frozen for 20-25 minutes.

steps: Heat the oven to 160°C. Brown the beef in the oil. Add the chopped onion and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the diced vegetables, purée, thyme, bay leaf and water. Cover and cook in the oven for 2 hours until the beef falls apart.
Take out the bay leaf. Shred the beef finely with two forks.
recipes.spoon: Chop into small soft pieces, or mash roughly if lumps are still new.
recipes.finger: Offer soft vegetable pieces and shredded beef.

steps: Cook the rice until soft.
Scramble the egg in half the oil until completely set, then chop it.
Stir-fry the finely diced carrot and the peas in the rest of the oil with the ginger for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the prawns and rice and stir-fry until the prawns are piping hot. Chop the prawns small and squash the peas for the baby. No soy sauce.
recipes.spoon: Chop into small soft pieces, or mash roughly if lumps are still new.
recipes.finger: Press the rice into small soft balls.
recipes.note: Use freshly cooked rice. Cool leftovers within 1 hour and use within 24 hours.

recipes.n: Chicken, leek and cream cheese pasta
steps: Dice the chicken small and slice the leek finely.
Cook both in the oil for 10 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the leek is soft.
Stir in the cream cheese and milk to make a sauce.
Cook the pasta until soft, adding the peas for the last 4 minutes. Mix everything and squash the peas.
recipes.spoon: Chop into small soft pieces, or mash roughly if lumps are still new.
recipes.finger: Offer pasta shapes and soft chicken pieces.

steps: Cook the pasta until soft, adding the peas for the last 4 minutes.
Heat the prawns in the oil for 3-4 minutes until piping hot, then chop them small.
Stir the cream cheese and lemon juice through the drained pasta with the prawns, and squash the peas.
recipes.spoon: Chop into small soft pieces, or mash roughly if lumps are still new.
recipes.finger: Offer pasta shapes and small prawn pieces.

steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Check the cod carefully for bones and cut it into finger-size strips.
Mix the ground hazelnuts and breadcrumbs. Dip the fish in beaten egg, then press into the crumb.
Bake on an oiled tray for 15-18 minutes until golden and the fish flakes easily.
Serve with potato boiled for 15 minutes and mashed.
recipes.spoon: Flake the fish into the mash.
recipes.finger: Offer the fish fingers whole.
recipes.fz: Freeze before baking; bake from frozen for 20-25 minutes.

ing: Smooth peanut butter (no added salt or sugar)
steps: Cut the chicken into thin strips and stir-fry in the oil for 6-7 minutes until cooked through.

Add the carrot cut into thin batons and steamed for 5 minutes first, the broccoli and the ginger with a splash of water, and cook for 6 minutes until everything squashes easily between your finger and thumb.
Cook the noodles until soft and cut them short.
Mix the peanut butter with the lemon juice and 2 tbsp hot water until runny, and toss everything together. No soy sauce for the baby.
recipes.spoon: Chop into small soft pieces, or mash roughly if lumps are still new.
recipes.finger: Offer short noodles, thin chicken strips and soft vegetables.

steps: Mash the banana and whisk in the egg, flour, milk and baking powder.
Cook small spoonfuls in a lightly oiled pan for 2-3 minutes on each side until cooked through with no wet batter.
recipes.spoon: Mash a pancake into yoghurt.
recipes.finger: Offer whole small pancakes or strips.

steps: Mix the oats, yoghurt, milk and linseed. Cover and leave in the fridge overnight.
In the morning, mash the raspberries or cut them lengthways into quarters, and stir in.
recipes.spoon: Serve as it is.
recipes.finger: Offer on a preloaded spoon.

steps: Scramble the egg in the butter over a low heat, stirring, until completely set with no runny egg.
Toast the bread, spread with mashed avocado and cut into narrow fingers.
recipes.spoon: Chop the egg small.
recipes.finger: Offer the toast fingers with pieces of egg.

steps: Whisk the egg, milk and cinnamon. Soak the bread in it on both sides.
Cook in the butter over a medium heat for 2-3 minutes on each side until the egg is fully set.
Cut into narrow fingers.
recipes.spoon: Chop small into yoghurt.
recipes.finger: Offer the fingers.

steps: Toast the bread on one side under the grill. Turn it over, sprinkle with the grated cheese and grill until melted.
Cut into narrow fingers. Cut the tomatoes lengthways into quarters.
recipes.spoon: Chop very small.
recipes.finger: Offer the fingers and quartered tomatoes.

steps: Mash the raspberries or cut them lengthways into quarters.
Stir into the yoghurt.
recipes.spoon: Serve as it is.
recipes.finger: Offer on a preloaded spoon.

steps: Heat the oven to 180°C. Core the apple and score the skin around the middle.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until very soft. Cool, scoop out the flesh and stir the cinnamon into the yoghurt to go with it.
recipes.spoon: Mash the apple into the yoghurt.
recipes.finger: Offer soft spoonfuls of apple.

recipes.n: Pear and apple crumble, no sugar
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C. Peel, core and dice the fruit and put it in a small dish with 2 tbsp water.
Rub the butter into the flour, oats, almonds and cinnamon until crumbly. Scatter over the fruit.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until the fruit is very soft.
recipes.spoon: Mash with a little yoghurt.
recipes.finger: Offer soft spoonfuls to scoop.

steps: Simmer the rice in the milk with the cinnamon for 30-35 minutes, stirring often, until thick and soft.
Mash in the banana.
recipes.spoon: Serve as it is.
recipes.finger: Offer on a preloaded spoon.
recipes.note: Cool within 1 hour, keep in the fridge and use within 24 hours.

steps: Wash the berries.
Cut every berry lengthways into quarters.
recipes.spoon: Mash with a fork.
recipes.finger: Offer the quarters.

steps: Remove the melon rind and seeds and cut into fingers.
Peel the kiwi and cut into wedges.
recipes.spoon: Mash together.
recipes.finger: Offer the soft fingers and wedges.

steps: Remove the stones and peel the fruit.
If the fruit is not very soft, steam the slices for 3-4 minutes. Let them cool.
recipes.spoon: Mash together.
recipes.finger: Offer soft slices.

steps: Brown the lamb, breaking it up, until there is no pink. Spoon off any fat.
Add the chopped onion and diced carrot, the purée, thyme and water. Simmer for 25 minutes, adding the peas for the last 5.
Boil the peeled potatoes for 15 minutes and mash with the butter and milk.
Make {name}'s pie first, before anything is seasoned: fill a small ovenproof dish with filling and mash. It bakes alongside the family dish in step 6.
Season the rest of the filling and mash with salt and pepper if you like, and fill the family dish.
Bake both at 200°C for 20-25 minutes until piping hot.
recipes.finger: Cut into small pieces that are easy to pick up. Squash the peas.
recipes.y: 2 adults and a toddler, with leftovers

steps: Finely chop the onion, carrot, mushrooms and garlic and soften them in the oil for 8 minutes.
Add the mince and cook, breaking it up, until there is no pink.
Add the tomatoes, purée and oregano and simmer for 30 minutes. Stir in the basil.
Take out {name}'s portion before seasoning.
Season the family's sauce with salt and pepper if you like.
Cook the spaghetti. Cut {name}'s into short lengths.
recipes.finger: Offer short spaghetti lengths coated in sauce.
recipes.y: 2 adults and a toddler, with leftovers

ing: Smooth cashew butter (no added salt or sugar)
steps: Soften the chopped onion, garlic and ginger in the oil for 6 minutes. Stir in the spices for 1 minute.
Add the diced chicken and cook for 5 minutes, then the tomatoes. Simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the cashew butter, yoghurt and spinach and warm through without boiling.
Take out {name}'s portion now.
Add salt and chilli to the family's curry if you like.
Cook the rice.
recipes.finger: Shred the chicken into small pieces; press rice into soft balls.
recipes.y: 2 adults and a toddler, with leftovers
recipes.note: Cool leftover rice within 1 hour, keep it in the fridge and use it within 24 hours.

steps: Boil the peeled potatoes for 15 minutes and mash with half the butter and a splash of the milk.
Poach the fish in the rest of the milk for 6-8 minutes. Lift out, flake, and remove all skin and bones.
Melt the remaining butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the poaching milk until thick. Add the fish, peas and parsley.
Fill a small dish for {name} first, before anything is seasoned, and squash the peas in it. It bakes alongside the family dish in step 6.
Season the family's filling and mash if you like, then fill the family dish.
Bake both at 190°C for 25-30 minutes until piping hot.
recipes.finger: Offer soft forkfuls or press into small cakes.
recipes.y: 2 adults and a toddler, with leftovers

steps: Soften the chopped onion, pepper and garlic in the oil for 8 minutes.
Add the mince and cook, breaking it up, until there is no pink. Stir in the spices.
Add the tomatoes, purée and beans and simmer for 30 minutes.
Take out {name}'s portion and squash every bean in it flat.
Add chilli and salt to the family's pot if you like.
Cook the rice.
recipes.finger: Offer on a preloaded spoon or mixed into rice balls.
recipes.y: 2 adults and a toddler, with leftovers
recipes.note: Cool leftover rice within 1 hour, keep it in the fridge and use it within 24 hours.

steps: Cut the chicken into thin strips and the vegetables into thin batons.
Stir-fry the chicken in the oil for 6-7 minutes until cooked through. Add the garlic, ginger and vegetables and cook for 6-8 minutes until soft, adding a splash of water.
Cook the noodles and toss them through.
Take out {name}'s portion and cut the noodles short.
Add soy sauce to the family's portions only.
recipes.finger: Offer thin chicken strips, soft vegetable batons and short noodles.
recipes.y: 2 adults and a toddler, with leftovers

steps: Peel, dice and boil the potato for 10 minutes until just soft.
Soften the chopped pepper in the oil in an ovenproof pan, then wilt in the spinach and add the potato.
Whisk the eggs, milk and grated cheese, pour over and cook gently for 5 minutes.
Finish under the grill for 5 minutes until fully set in the middle with no runny egg.
recipes.finger: Cut into fingers.
recipes.y: 2 adults and a toddler, with leftovers
recipes.note: No seasoning needed: adults can add salt at the table.

steps: Cook the rice in plenty of water until soft, as the packet says.
Soften the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil for 6 minutes. Stir in the spices for 1 minute.
Add the rinsed lentils, tomatoes and water. Simmer for 25 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted.
Take out {name}'s portion.
Season the family's dhal with salt and chilli if you like.
Serve with rice and a spoon of yoghurt.
recipes.finger: Offer thick dhal on a preloaded spoon with soft rice balls.
recipes.y: 2 adults and a toddler, with leftovers
recipes.note: Cool leftover rice within 1 hour, keep it in the fridge and use it within 24 hours.

steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Halve the potatoes and roast in the oil for 20 minutes.
Add the salmon, beans and tomatoes and roast for 12-15 minutes until the fish flakes.
Take out {name}'s portion: remove the skin, check the salmon carefully for bones, and cut the tomatoes lengthways into quarters.
Squeeze over the lemon, scatter the dill, and season the family's portions if you like.
recipes.finger: Offer flakes of salmon, soft potato pieces, whole soft beans and quartered tomatoes.
recipes.y: 2 adults and a toddler, with leftovers

steps: Heat the oven to 160°C. Toss the beef in the flour and brown it in the oil. Add the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add the diced vegetables, purée, herbs and water. Cover and cook in the oven for 2.5 hours until the beef falls apart.
Remove the bay leaf. Take out {name}'s portion and shred the beef finely.
Season the family's casserole if you like.
recipes.finger: Offer shredded beef and soft vegetable pieces.
recipes.y: 2 adults and a toddler, with leftovers

steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Mix the mince, breadcrumbs, egg, courgette and oregano and roll into 24 balls.
Bake for 20 minutes until cooked through with no pink.
Simmer the tomatoes with the garlic, oil and basil for 15 minutes, then add the meatballs.
Cook the pasta until soft and cut it short for {name}.
Take out {name}'s portion and cut the meatballs into quarters.
Season the family's sauce if you like, and serve with the pasta.
recipes.finger: Offer quartered meatballs and pasta shapes.
recipes.y: 2 adults and a toddler, with leftovers

steps: Cook the rice in plenty of water until soft, as the packet says.
Soften the onion, pepper and garlic in the oil for 8 minutes. Stir in the spices.
Add the diced sweet potato, tomatoes and beans. Simmer for 25 minutes until the potato is soft.
Take out {name}'s portion and squash every bean flat.
Add chilli and salt to the family's pot if you like. Serve with rice and yoghurt.
recipes.finger: Offer on a preloaded spoon, or mixed into soft rice balls.
recipes.y: 2 adults and a toddler, with leftovers
recipes.note: Cool leftover rice within 1 hour, keep it in the fridge and use it within 24 hours.

recipes.n: Chicken, broccoli and mushroom pasta bake
steps: Dice the chicken small. Cook it with the sliced leek and mushrooms in half the butter for 10 minutes until cooked through.
Cook the pasta, adding the broccoli for the last 5 minutes.
Melt the rest of the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk until thick. Add half the grated cheese.
Mix everything, put in a dish, top with the rest of the cheese and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes.
Serve {name}'s portion first; season the rest at the table if you like.
recipes.finger: Cut into small pieces that are easy to pick up.
recipes.y: 2 adults and a toddler, with leftovers

steps: Cook the rice. Cube the tofu and fry in half the oil until golden.
Scramble the eggs in a little oil until completely set, then chop.
Stir-fry the diced carrot and pepper with the garlic and ginger for 6 minutes until soft, then add the peas, rice, tofu and egg.
Take out {name}'s portion and squash the peas.
Add soy sauce to the family's portions only.
recipes.finger: Offer tofu pieces and rice pressed into soft balls.
recipes.y: 2 adults and a toddler, with leftovers
recipes.note: Use freshly cooked rice. Cool leftovers within 1 hour and use within 24 hours.

steps: Mix the flour, yeast, water and oil into a dough. No salt. Knead for 5 minutes and rest for 1 hour.
Roll out thinly. Spread with the blended tomatoes and oregano, then add thinly sliced pepper, mushrooms and the mozzarella.
Bake at 220°C for 12-15 minutes.
Cut {name}'s into narrow fingers.
recipes.finger: Offer narrow fingers.
recipes.y: 2 adults and a toddler, with leftovers

steps: Soften the sliced onion and peppers in the oil for 10 minutes. Add the garlic and spices.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes until thick.
Make 4 dips and crack in the eggs. Cover and cook for 8-10 minutes until the whites and yolks are fully set.
Serve {name}'s egg chopped with sauce and toast fingers; season the family's at the table.
recipes.finger: Offer chopped egg and toast fingers to dip.
recipes.y: 2 adults and a toddler, with leftovers

steps: Cook the spaghetti.
Soften the garlic and the grated courgette in the oil for 5 minutes. Add the tomatoes, halved, and cook for 5 minutes until they burst.
Add the prawns and cook for 3-4 minutes until piping hot. Stir in the basil, lemon and spaghetti.
Take out {name}'s portion: chop the prawns small, cut the spaghetti short, and squash any whole tomato pieces or cut them lengthways into quarters.
Season the family's portions with salt, pepper or chilli if you like.
recipes.finger: Offer short spaghetti lengths and small prawn pieces.
recipes.y: 2 adults and a toddler, with leftovers

steps: Mash the beans with the cumin until there are no whole beans.
Spread over half the tortilla, add the pepper and grated cheese, and fold.
Dry-fry for 2-3 minutes on each side until the cheese melts. Cut into narrow strips.
recipes.finger: Offer the strips.

steps: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes until fully set. Cool and peel.
Mash with the yoghurt and chives. No raw-egg mayonnaise.
Spread between the slices and cut into narrow fingers.
recipes.finger: Offer the fingers.

steps: Roast the courgette and pepper strips in half the oil at 200°C for 20 minutes until soft.
Blend the chickpeas, tahini, lemon and the rest of the oil into a smooth hummus.
Spread over the wrap, add the vegetables, roll up, and cut into short narrow pieces.
recipes.finger: Offer the pieces.

recipes.n: Pea and potato soup with toast fingers
steps: Soften the onion in the oil. Add the diced potato and water and simmer for 15 minutes. No stock cubes.
Add the peas and mint for 5 minutes, then blend smooth.
Swirl in the yoghurt. Serve with toast fingers to dip.
recipes.finger: Offer toast fingers to dip; the soup is thick enough to scoop.

recipes.n: Couscous with roasted vegetables and chickpeas
steps: Roast the diced courgette and pepper in the oil at 200°C for 20 minutes until soft.
Pour 150 ml boiling water over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes and fluff.
Squash the chickpeas with a fork and mix everything with the lemon and parsley.
recipes.finger: Press into soft balls to pick up.

steps: Cook the rice until soft. Heat the oven to 190°C and bake the salmon for 12 minutes; flake it and check carefully for bones.
Cook the peas and squash them.
Peel the cucumber and cut it into thin short batons. Slice the avocado. Arrange everything in a bowl.
recipes.finger: Offer salmon flakes, avocado slices, cucumber batons and rice balls.
recipes.note: Cool leftover rice within 1 hour and use within 24 hours.

steps: Soften the onion, garlic and diced carrot in the oil for 8 minutes. Stir in the cumin.
Add the rinsed lentils and water and simmer for 25 minutes. Blend smooth. No stock cubes.
Serve with toast fingers.
recipes.finger: Offer toast fingers to dip.

recipes.n: Scrambled egg with toast and tomatoes
steps: Scramble the eggs with the milk in the butter over a low heat until completely set with no runny egg.
Toast the bread and cut into fingers. Cut the tomatoes lengthways into quarters.
recipes.finger: Offer egg pieces, toast fingers and quartered tomatoes.

recipes.n: Porridge with grated apple and almonds
steps: Cook the oats in the milk for 4-5 minutes until creamy.
Stir in the finely grated apple, ground almonds and cinnamon.
recipes.finger: Let it thicken and offer on a preloaded spoon.

recipes.n: Yoghurt with strawberries and ground hazelnuts
steps: Cut the strawberries lengthways into quarters.
Stir the hazelnuts and linseed into the yoghurt and top with the fruit.
recipes.finger: Offer on a preloaded spoon with the quartered berries.

steps: Crumble the tofu and cook it in the oil with the turmeric for 4 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted. Serve with toast fingers.
recipes.finger: Offer the soft tofu crumbs and toast fingers.

steps: Blend the chickpeas, tahini, lemon and oil with a little water until smooth.
Peel the cucumber and cut it into thin, short batons.
recipes.finger: Offer the batons to dip.

steps: Cut the cheese into short, thin strips.
Cut each grape lengthways into quarters.
recipes.finger: Offer the strips and quarters.

steps: Peel and finely grate the apple.
Stir into the yoghurt with the cinnamon.
recipes.finger: Offer on a preloaded spoon.

steps: Heat the oven to 180°C. Mash the bananas and mix in the oats, almonds and cinnamon.
Roll into 12 balls, flatten slightly, and bake for 15 minutes until golden. No sugar needed.
recipes.finger: Offer whole bites or halves.

recipes.n: Soft carrot sticks with tahini dip
steps: Cut the carrot into narrow batons and steam for 8 minutes until soft.
Stir the tahini into the yoghurt.

recipeRules.t: No added salt, stock cubes or gravy
No added sugar, syrup, sweeteners, honey or fruit juice
No honey before 12 months (never used at any age in First Meal)
No whole nuts; nut and seed butters thinned or spread thinly, never by the spoonful
Eggs always fully cooked
recipeRules.note: The NHS allows lightly cooked eggs only with the UK's British Lion stamp; internationally First Meal always cooks eggs through.

recipeRules.t: Pasteurised cheese only; no mould-ripened or blue cheese
Shellfish always cooked until piping hot; never raw
No shark, swordfish or marlin; no tinned or smoked fish (salt)
recipeRules.note: No tinned or smoked fish is First Meal's own salt caution.

recipeRules.t: Cows' milk only in cooking before 12 months; no rice drinks
Small round foods cut lengthways into quarters, or mashed
Hard fruit and vegetables cooked soft or grated, never raw chunks
No popcorn, sweetcorn kernels, dried fruit, sausages or processed meat
Whole beans, chickpeas and peas squashed, mashed or blended
Meat minced, shredded or in small pieces; fish and meat checked for bones
Cheese grated, melted or in short thin strips
Bread toasted or cut into narrow fingers
Family recipes take the baby's portion out before any seasoning
Each allergen introduced on its own, at breakfast, starting with about 1/4 teaspoon
recipeRules.note: Porridge oats appear from week 3, a week before wheat: oats are not wheat, and the 'may contain gluten' note is shown with them for families who need it.

recipeRules.t: Spinach only from 12 months (First Meal's own extra caution)
recipeRules.note: Spinach waits until 12 months as a cautious choice on nitrates; the NHS itself allows it from 6 months.

recipeRules.t: Rice dishes carry the NHS rice storage note
Both serving forms written for babies under 12 months; finger form for toddlers
Wording works for any baby: no she/her, and the name is a placeholder
Every ingredient comes from the checked ingredient table

planRules.t: Meals a day follow the stage: 1 at first, 2 from week 3, 3 from week 7, puddings from 9 months, 2 snacks from 12 months
Every meal uses a recipe written for that stage and that kind of meal
An allergen appears only after its introduction week, apart from the introduction breakfasts
One new allergen a week, introduced at breakfast on Monday, Wednesday and Friday
planRules.note: ASCIA asks for one new allergen per meal. First Meal goes further: one a week, on Monday, Wednesday and Friday breakfasts.

planRules.t: Once introduced, every allergen appears at least twice a week
Meat, fish or egg every day from week 3
No more than 2 portions of oily fish a week
planRules.note: The NHS limit is 2 portions a week for girls and 4 for boys. First Meal uses 2 for everyone.

planRules.t: No recipe more than twice a week (introduction breakfasts and first tastes excepted), and never twice in a day
From 12 months, tea is a family meal the adults eat too
All common allergens introduced before 12 months
A frozen portion is served within 13 weeks of cooking
planRules.note: First Meal's own caution; the NHS gives no fixed time for frozen baby food. Added Oct 24 after the content review.

planRules.t: In the toddler weeks, no breakfast or main dish more than once a week, snacks and puddings at most twice, and egg at breakfast at most three times a week
planRules.note: First Meal's own variety rule for weeks 27–78, added Oct 24 after the content review found the same breakfasts and lunches week after week. The freezer still drives lunches: a batch is eaten over the following weeks, oldest first, within 13 weeks (P11).
